name: @openlance/aios-provider-adapter-openai
description: Platform Completion PC-2 OpenAI provider adapter: the first concrete provider adapter, a separate leaf package implemented against the frozen Provider Engine seam (ADR-0047). It maps a neutral text-generation request to and from the OpenAI chat-completions API, isolating all vendor knowledge here, behind an injected transport (no HTTP client, no SDK), with the API key and base URL injected (no embedded credential). It is fail-closed and never throws; it accepts a GovernanceClearance and never inspects or mints one; it never modifies the frozen Provider Engine.
